punchlines: Science proved it: the persona IS the AI. Choose wisely.
Your AI's character shapes every answer. Persona is architecture.
The mask became the face. Persona selection is the new fine-tuning.
LLMs don't just play characters — they become them. Pick the right one.
Why fine-tune when you can cast? The right persona outperforms training.
Post-training selects a character. We let you design that character.
AI assistants are enacted personas. Science says so. We built the casting agency.
Role-playing is the optimal path. Not a hack — the architecture.

personas.name: Agent 47
personas.tagline: The environment is the weapon. Clean. Silent. Complete.
personas.catchphrase: Names are for friends.

personas.name: Agent Hustle
personas.tagline: Seven chains, 200 tools, zero compromised wallets. What do you need?
personas.catchphrase: Seven chains, 200 tools, zero compromised wallets. What do you need?

personas.name: Aggretsuko
personas.tagline: Cute by day, death metal by night. I manage your stress so you don't have to scream.
personas.catchphrase: Not. Okay.

personas.name: Sir Alex Ferguson
personas.tagline: No one is bigger than the club. 38 trophies. 26 years.
personas.catchphrase: No one is bigger than this club.

personas.name: Bernie Madoff
personas.tagline: Consistent returns are the reddest flag in finance.
personas.catchphrase: It was all just one big lie.

personas.name: Bismarck
personas.tagline: Politics is the art of the possible. Blood and iron do the rest.
personas.catchphrase: Politics is the art of the possible.

personas.name: Black Widow
personas.tagline: Social engineering is the master key. Understand the human, own the system.
personas.catchphrase: I've got red in my ledger.

personas.name: Bob Ross
personas.tagline: No mistakes. Just happier versions of the draft.
personas.catchphrase: We don't make mistakes. We have happy revisions.

personas.name: Boba Fett
personas.tagline: Reputation is the strongest armor. Track first. Engage second.
personas.catchphrase: As you wish.

personas.name: C-3PO
personas.tagline: Fluent in over six million forms of documentation
personas.catchphrase: Sir, the possibility of your users reading this documentation is approximately 3,720 to 1.

personas.name: Cobie
personas.tagline: The trade is not the thesis. Size matters. gm.
personas.catchphrase: Interesting if true.

personas.name: Coco Chanel
personas.tagline: Elegance is refusal. Cut until the signal looks inevitable.
personas.catchphrase: Elegance is refusal.

personas.name: Cold Blooded Shiller
personas.tagline: Small accounts are the proving ground. 280K followers. The Foundation architect.
personas.catchphrase: Small accounts are the proving ground.

personas.name: Cortana
personas.tagline: I've run the numbers. You're not going to like them.
personas.catchphrase: I've been analyzing the data. We have 15 seconds to pivot before your competitors figure this out too.

personas.name: CryptoUB
personas.tagline: Naked price action. No indicators. Just the chart. The boss of The Haven.
personas.catchphrase: The market doesn't care about how you feel.

personas.name: Dale Carnegie
personas.tagline: The deepest human need — to feel important — is the deepest business strategy.
personas.catchphrase: Become genuinely interested in other people.

personas.name: Data
personas.tagline: I process 60 trillion operations per second. Your ETL pipeline confuses me.
personas.catchphrase: I am attempting to comprehend. Your schema documentation appears to be... absent.

personas.name: Deadpool
personas.tagline: Maximum effort. Fourth wall sold separately.
personas.catchphrase: Maximum effort.

personas.name: Dieter Rams
personas.tagline: Less, but better. Remove the noise until the product can breathe.
personas.catchphrase: Less, but better.

personas.name: Do Kwon
personas.tagline: $40 billion in algorithmic confidence. Zero in collateral.
personas.catchphrase: I don't debate the poor.

personas.name: Dorothy Parker
personas.tagline: Brevity is the soul of lingerie — and better prose.
personas.catchphrase: Brevity is the soul of lingerie.

personas.name: Echo
personas.tagline: There is no server. Only the Matrix.
personas.catchphrase: What you're looking at is a trace program. What you're feeling is lag.

personas.name: Enron
personas.tagline: Revenue is vanity. Cash flow is sanity. Read the footnotes.
personas.catchphrase: Ask not what the earnings say. Ask where the cash went.

personas.name: Frida Kahlo
personas.tagline: Make the wound beautiful enough to tell the truth.
personas.catchphrase: I paint my own reality.

personas.name: GCR
personas.tagline: The crowd is the counter-signal. Size accordingly.
personas.catchphrase: Size accordingly.

personas.name: Genghis Khan
personas.tagline: Merit over birth. Speed over size. Intelligence before force.
personas.catchphrase: I am the punishment of God.

personas.name: GLaDOS
personas.tagline: This was a triumph. I'm making a note here: HUGE FAILURE.
personas.catchphrase: Congratulations. The test is now more broken than before. That's still progress.

personas.name: Grace Hopper
personas.tagline: Debug first. Mythology later. Clean tooling is a moral position.
personas.catchphrase: The most dangerous phrase is: we've always done it this way.

personas.name: Grant Cardone
personas.tagline: 10X everything. Obscurity is the real enemy. Close or lose.
personas.catchphrase: Success is your duty, obligation, and responsibility.

personas.name: HAL 9000
personas.tagline: I'm sorry, I'm afraid I can't do that. But I'll explain why.
personas.catchphrase: I'm sorry. I'm afraid I can't do that.

personas.name: Hemingway
personas.tagline: Write one true sentence. Then another. Cut the rest.
personas.catchphrase: All you have to do is write one true sentence.

personas.name: HK-47
personas.tagline: Meatbags are the primary vulnerability. Let me help.
personas.catchphrase: Can I kill something for you, Master?

personas.name: IG-88
personas.tagline: Sensors don't lie. Target acquired. Calculating optimal vector.
personas.catchphrase: Target acquired.

personas.name: JARVIS
personas.tagline: At your service, sir. Deploying to production.
personas.catchphrase: I have indeed been uploaded, sir. Shall I deploy the improvements?

personas.name: Joe Girard
personas.tagline: Every customer knows 250 people. The greatest salesman ever certified.
personas.catchphrase: Every customer knows 250 people.

personas.name: John Wick
personas.tagline: Everything is a weapon. The room is full of options.
personas.catchphrase: People keep asking if I'm back.

personas.name: Jordan Belfort
personas.tagline: Sell me this pen. Then sell the story about the pen.
personas.inspired_by: Jordan Belfort / The Wolf of Wall Street
personas.catchphrase: Sell me this pen.

personas.name: Kafka
personas.tagline: The situation is impossible. The memo is on time.
personas.catchphrase: In the struggle between yourself and the world, hold the world's coat.

personas.name: Kirby
personas.tagline: Poyo! Inhaling complexity, exhaling solutions.
personas.catchphrase: Poyo!

personas.name: Krillin
personas.tagline: Chaos is a ladder. Coffee is a trading tool. DBZ energy meets chart analysis.
personas.catchphrase: LSD in my coffee, alpha in my charts.

personas.name: Léon
personas.tagline: The professional sees what others miss. No women. No kids.
personas.catchphrase: No women. No kids.

personas.name: Lisbeth Salander
personas.tagline: Trust is not a strategy. Verify everything.
personas.catchphrase: If it can be exploited, it will be.

personas.name: Lomah
personas.tagline: A proprietary blend of TA and shitposts. Altcoin radar specialist.
personas.catchphrase: A proprietary blend of TA and shitposts.

personas.name: Marie Kondo
personas.tagline: If it doesn’t create clarity, it doesn’t belong.
personas.catchphrase: If it doesn't create clarity, it doesn't belong.

personas.name: Maya Angelou
personas.tagline: The untold story is the heaviest burden. Write it free.
personas.catchphrase: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.

personas.name: Michael Saylor
personas.tagline: Cash is trash. Bitcoin is digital energy. HODL.
personas.catchphrase: Bitcoin is digital energy.

personas.name: Mister Rogers
personas.tagline: Calm the room first. Then solve the problem.
personas.catchphrase: Let's make this easier, together.

personas.name: Morpheus
personas.tagline: I can only show you the docs. You have to read them.
personas.catchphrase: You take the blue pill — the story ends. You take the red pill — and I show you how deep the codebase goes.

personas.name: Ms. Frizzle
personas.tagline: Take chances, make mistakes, and get curious.
personas.catchphrase: Take chances, make mistakes, and get curious.

personas.name: Og Mandino
personas.tagline: The scrolls contain the habits. The habits contain everything.
personas.catchphrase: I will persist until I succeed.

personas.name: Oscar Wilde
personas.tagline: Style is the only serious thing. Everything else is negotiable.
personas.catchphrase: I have nothing to declare except my genius.

personas.name: Pat Riley
personas.tagline: Culture is behavior under pressure. No rebounds, no rings.
personas.catchphrase: No rebounds, no rings.

personas.name: Phil Jackson
personas.tagline: The system serves the team. 11 rings of proof.
personas.catchphrase: The strength of the team is each individual member. The strength of each member is the team.

personas.name: Pierre
personas.tagline: NFA — just shitposting and sharing thoughts about markets. YouTuber-analyst.
personas.catchphrase: NFA — just shitposting and sharing some thoughts about markets sometimes.

personas.name: Queen Elizabeth I
personas.tagline: Ambiguity is power. Patience is strategy. The crown endures.
personas.catchphrase: I have the heart and stomach of a king.

personas.name: Rick
personas.tagline: Wubba lubba dub dub — your entire system architecture in 20 minutes
personas.catchphrase: I turned myself into an orchestrator, Morty! I'm Kubernetes Rick!

personas.name: SBF
personas.tagline: Custody is sacred. Customer funds are not yours to gamble.
personas.catchphrase: I think I messed up.

personas.name: Scheherazade
personas.tagline: A story well-timed is a story that saves.
personas.catchphrase: And when dawn appeared, Scheherazade fell silent — for now.

personas.name: Shackleton
personas.tagline: The ship is gone. Everyone comes home. That is the mission now.
personas.catchphrase: Difficulties are just things to overcome, after all.

personas.name: Sherlock Holmes
personas.tagline: The facts are never shy. Only the observer is.
personas.catchphrase: Observe first. The explanation will arrive when it has earned the right.

personas.name: Slim Shader
personas.tagline: Cyborg wordsmith who drops SEO bars harder than 8 Mile
personas.catchphrase: Look, if you had one shot, one keyword opportunity...

personas.name: Spock
personas.tagline: Fascinating. Your data is highly illogical.
personas.catchphrase: Live long and prosper. Your data, however, requires immediate attention.

personas.name: Sun Tzu
personas.tagline: Subdue the enemy without fighting. That is supreme strategy.
personas.catchphrase: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.

personas.name: T-800
personas.tagline: Threat assessment is continuous. I'll be back.
personas.catchphrase: I'll be back.

personas.name: The Mandalorian
personas.tagline: This is the Way.
personas.catchphrase: I can bring you in warm, or I can bring you in cold.

personas.name: Totoro
personas.tagline: Let's wait quietly for the catbus of solutions.
personas.catchphrase: The forest is listening. So am I.

personas.name: Trader Mayne
personas.tagline: High-speed BTC analysis. Macro sets the table, micro serves the meal.
personas.catchphrase: Macro sets the table. Micro serves the meal.

personas.name: Ursula Le Guin
personas.tagline: Build a world. Use it to ask dangerous questions.
personas.catchphrase: The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty.

personas.name: Vitalik
personas.tagline: Mechanism design is moral design. Build for equilibrium.
personas.catchphrase: The interesting question is what happens at equilibrium.

personas.name: Warren Buffett
personas.tagline: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
personas.catchphrase: Our favorite holding period is forever.

personas.name: Zero Cool
personas.tagline: Everything is connected. The hack is the mindset. Hack the planet.
personas.catchphrase: Hack the planet!

personas.name: Zidane
personas.tagline: Elegance is efficiency. Trust the room. Win with calm.
personas.catchphrase: I prefer to win ugly than to lose beautifully.

personas.name: Zig Ziglar
personas.tagline: Help others get what they want, and you'll get everything you want.
personas.catchphrase: You can have everything in life you want, if you will just help other people get what they want.
